pathAssistantSteps.info:
Prior to escalating the closure request, the following needs to be confirmed:

  • There are no pending transactions on the account(s)
  • The card has been disabled in CTM
  • The account balances have been zeroed out
  • There is no interest accrued on the account(s)
  • The status of the account(s) has been set to Closed in CAP
